messages:
emily_pm: Quick thread following customer feedback: Large fintech customer asked for an "opted-in" migration plan plus a clear pin expiration cadence. They also want SLAs for rollback. Need a compact alpha plan we can present in the customer call next week.

tonya_research: Suggest we define three migration modes: (1) Manual pin (customer controls TTL), (2) Assisted migration (hand-holding + extended grace), (3) Auto-roll (scheduled, opt-in with warning). Each needs clear success/fail criteria.

ryan_platform: From platform POV: success criteria = no >20% p95 latency regression, error-rate bump <0.5% absolute, and no increase in kernel OOMs. We should capture baseline runs and a short perf report template.

gabe_support: Support constraints: require a customer-facing rollback button in the console plus email comms template and an API opt-out for auto-roll. Also log-level tagging so ops can trace which requests hit the migrated model.

emily_pm: Proposed alpha launch checklist:
- Baseline perf sweep and mem footprint comparison (platform)
- 250-prompt eval suite + quick human spot-check (research)
- Console UX for pin + rollback (PM/Platform)
- Comm templates + SLA wording (support)
- Canary routing + auto-rollback rules (platform)

tonya_research: For evals: use 250 prompts split 60/40 generative vs instruction-following. Automated metrics: ROUGE-ish, answer overlap, model confidence proxies. Human panel: 5 reviewers, blind pairwise A/B vs current pinned model. Gate: human preference drop <7%.

emily_pm: Incentives idea: 2 options
1) Migration credit: one month of hosting credits for assisted migrations.
2) Pin holiday: 45-day extended pin TTL for strategic accounts that opt into assisted migration.

gabe_support: Also offer a "white-glove" migration option: SRE/DevEx runbook + two 4-hour windows for assisted cutover. That helps enterprise customers who need a tighter rollback SLA.

ryan_platform: Canary mechanics: create a routing object with fields {version, cohort_label, weight, metric_thresholds}. Example JSON snippet:
```json
{"version":"catalog-v3.0-q4","cohort_label":"fintech-alpha","weight":0.15,"metric_thresholds":{"p95_ms":220,"error_rate_abs":0.005}}
```

ci-bot: Canary started for catalog-v3.0-q4 targeting cohort 'fintech-alpha' - run_id: run-2026-04-02-09

tonya_research: Timeline estimate: perf sweep 36h, automated evals 24h, human spot-check 48h (can be parallelized). So total ~72h to alpha report.

emily_pm: Delivery plan: I'll draft a 1-pager (alpha plan + SLAs + comms) today. Ryan, can you produce the perf template and console mock for rollback button by tomorrow noon? Gabe, can you prepare email + support-runbook?

gabe_support: Yes. I'll also add a short checklist for customers: required contact info, traffic % targets, and expected maintenance windows.

emily_pm: Risk notes: we should flag customers on Dedicated who have pinned hardware constraints; auto-migrate must be blocked for those. Add that to the gating rules.

ryan_platform: Agreed. Add gating rule: if tenant is on dedicated-reservation or has explicit hardware-affinity tag -> require manual opt-in.

tonya_research: One more: include a small regression-monitoring dashboard with rolling windows (1h/6h/24h) for p95, errors, and correctness sampling. That should be part of the canary closure criteria.

emily_pm: Nice. Okay action items: emily -> 1-pager + customer slide (EOD), ryan -> perf template + console mock (tomorrow noon), tonya -> eval set + human panel plan (72h), gabe -> comms + runbook (EOD). Reconvene in 24h. Thanks! :rocket:
